blocks.content: Time to build the first thing players will see—the start screen!
You'll add a title, simple instructions, and a button to start the game.
Add content to the #start-screen div. Include an h1 element with "Whack-a-Mole" as the title,
A p element with game instructions about clicking moles in 30 seconds, and a button element with id "start-button" containing the text "Start Game".
